instagram.text:
هل أخبرتَه؟ 🤍
Have you told them?

There's someone you love for the sake of Allah, and they may not know it. The Prophet ﷺ told us to say it, and the hadith even gives the reply.

Send this to them, or tag them in the comments 🤍
To a sister: «أحبّكِ في الله».
Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.

Hadith: Sunan Abi Dawud 5124 (al-Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib) · Sunan Abi Dawud 5125 (Anas ibn Malik) · Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2390 (Mu'adh ibn Jabal) · Sahih Muslim 2566 (Abu Hurayrah). Translations: HadeethEnc.com.

#hadith #brotherhood #islamicreminders #islam #حديث

metadata.altText: Cover: two glowing gold lanterns under an arch on a night-blue background with the question هل أخبرتَه؟, have you told them? Four authentic hadith and a card to send.
Hadith 1 of 4, tell him, in Arabic with English: When a man loves his brother, he should tell him that he loves him. Sunan Abi Dawud 5124.

Hadith 2 of 4, how it was said, first part, in Arabic with English: a man was with the Prophet and another man passed by. He said, O Messenger of Allah, I love this man. The Prophet said, Have you told him? He said, No. He said, Tell him. Sunan Abi Dawud 5125.
Hadith 2 of 4 continued, in Arabic with English: He went after him and said, I love you for Allah's sake. He said, May the One you love me for His sake love you! Sunan Abi Dawud 5125.

Hadith 3 of 4, their reward, in Arabic with English: Allah, the Almighty, said: Those who love one another for the sake of My glory will have pulpits of light for which the prophets and martyrs will envy them. Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2390.

Hadith 4 of 4, on the Day of Judgment, in Arabic with English: Allah, the Almighty, will say on the Day of Judgment: Where are those who loved each other for My glory? Today, I will shelter them under My shade the day when there is no shade but My shade. Sahih Muslim 2566.

A card with a gold border on teal, to you: I love you for Allah's sake. And the reply: May the One you love me for His sake love you! From the hadith in Sunan Abi Dawud 5125. Screenshot it and send it to them.
Closing card with a gold lantern: send this to someone you love for Allah, or tag them in the comments; keep us in your du'a; follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.
